task.title: Diagnostic: Troubleshoot schema cache and API validation errors
task.shortdesc: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. Diagnose unavailable schema cache, unknown schema channel, and Firefox policies validation failures without patching generated schema artifacts.

prereq.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. Use this procedure when POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-152, POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/beta-999, or user-facing validation returns 400, 404, 422, or 503; a non-object document can return 200 ok=false with Expected object with policy mappings.

context.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. BPM validation depends on maintained schema channels and local schema/cache configuration. The diagnostic records whether the issue is request shape, unknown profile, invalid Firefox policy data, or unavailable schema cache.

step.cmd: Diagnostic 1: Record the exact validation request and response.

info.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. Store sanitized request body hash, schema channel, HTTP status, detail, message, error, and issues. Keep the candidate policies.json outside logs if it contains customer values.

Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. A non-object document or missing document.policies is operator input, not a schema-cache defect; current BPM can report this as 200 ok=false. Focused rerun: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-152 with {"document":{"policies":{"DisableTelemetry":true}}}.

step.cmd: Diagnostic 3: Classify schema-channel and cache failures.

info.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. A profile such as beta-999 can return 404; an unavailable registered schema can return 503. Check BPM_SCHEMA_BASE_URL, BPM_SCHEMA_CACHE_DIR, and BPM_SCHEMA_HTTP_TIMEOUT before any broader rebuild.

step.cmd: Diagnostic 4: Use maintained refresh and validation checks.

info.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. Focused rerun: ./.venv/bin/pytest -q -m docs_contract documentation/tests/contract/test_api_openapi_drift.py for API documentation drift, or product schema tests when the API behavior changed. Do not hand-edit app/schemas/cache or generated Firefox skeletons.

step.cmd: Diagnostic 5: Stop unsafe recovery and preserve evidence.

info.p: Cette procédure conserve les evidence, protège les données utilisateur et sépare operator action de product defect. If the same valid request changes status across runs, preserve response bodies, source revision, cache path, and environment variables.
info.note: Do not edit generated schema artifacts or database rows as routine recovery; separate product defects from operator payload errors.

result.p: L’opérateur obtient un diagnostic classifié, préserve user data et connaît le prochain smallest rerun. The operator has a classified validation failure with a smallest rerun and no hidden schema mutation.

postreq.p: Après correction, revenez au workflow Administrator/DevOps lié et relancez seulement les checks affectés. After validation succeeds, return to validate-before-apply or import-review-export workflows.
